messages:
Alice Ramos: Hey team — quick inventory reconciliation for APAC racks. Vendor manifest shows 12 H100s arriving to APAC1 on 2026-03-22, but our GCE quota usage only shows 8 active in our project. Has anyone reconciled where the other 4 are allocated? (cc @Ben Cho)
Ben Cho: Looking now. Vendor portal shows 12 allocated to our account, but 4 are marked 'pending install' with a partner DC. Pinged them for status.
Priya Nair: On infra side I see 4 nodes stuck in provision: node-asia-rt-3/4 stuck at "firmware-update". Quick check: `gcloud compute instances list --filter="tags.items:apac-h100"` returned 8 instances — could be a tagging/quota visibility mismatch.
Ben Cho: Partner replied: 4 units staged under vendor job ID VND-9933, awaiting invoice clearance before rack install.
Marco Li: From finance — invoice for VND-9933 hasn't been approved because PO line items didn't match the manifest SKU count (PO shows 10, manifest 12). Prepping PO correction now.
Alice Ramos: Timeline matter — we need those 4 in the Dedicated pool for demos by EOD Friday. If invoice clears today can partner install tomorrow?
Marco Li: If we sign off today, partner can schedule install tomorrow AM APAC local time. I updated the finance ticket with corrected PO.
invoicing-bot: Invoice VND-9933 status: awaiting PO_correction. Link: https://finance.internal/invoices/VND-9933
Priya Nair: Once partner confirms install I'll run preflight: smoke `kubectl get nodes -l pool=apac-h100 -o wide` and NVML health checks. Also will reserve 4 GPUs in the billing project as a temporary safeguard — Ben, can you confirm quota availability?
Ben Cho: Confirmed: vendor-project-apac has 4 spare GPU quota that we can attach to the provisioned pool. I'll annotate vendor ticket to release quota once invoice clears.
Alice Ramos: Excellent. Ben/Marco — post here once invoice is updated and partner confirms slot, I'll share canary test plan and loop oncall for the window. :thumbsup:
Ben Cho: Noted, will update this thread.
Marco Li: PO corrected and resubmitted, sent approval to partner. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
invoicing-bot: Invoice VND-9933 status: approved -> scheduled for partner install.
Priya Nair: Partner ETA confirmed: 2026-03-25 09:00 APAC1. I'll schedule canary at 10:30 and post checklist items here.
Alice Ramos: Great — will close thread after canary passes. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
